tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: See every directory MCP Lister can list your server in, with requirements. Free, anonymous, read-only.

tools.name: submit_server
tools.description: Give a public GitHub repository URL. With an API key (header X-API-Key or Bearer) it saves a launch intake and finds eligible directories. Without a key it runs the free readiness check and tells you how to continue. Never submits to a directory or charges anything; payment and authorization are sep

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Requires API key. Pass launch_id for one launch, or omit it to see all your launches with each directory result. Submitted is not approved.

tools.name: list_directories
tools.description: Anonymous catalog with source references and requirements. Discovery does not establish purchase eligibility; run a full authenticated preflight.

tools.name: check_repository
tools.description: Anonymous free diagnostic for a public GitHub repository. This is not the per-destination purchase preflight.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Anonymous signup returns a new account API key once. Save it securely; email is not an access or recovery credential.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Requires API key. Read account and configured billing/execution availability. Generic launch credits are not sold.

tools.name: connection_instructions
tools.description: Read-only instructions for direct HTTPS credential upload. Never put third-party secrets in chat or MCP tool arguments.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: Requires API key. Returns owned connection IDs, providers, expiry and revocation metadata. Never returns plaintext or ciphertext.

tools.name: revoke_connection
tools.description: Requires explicit owner authorization. Revoking a connection prevents jobs using it from completing until reconnected.

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: Requires API key; returns only your saved profiles.

tools.name: create_server
tools.description: Requires API key. Save accurate public profile fields before checking all selected destination prerequisites. Smithery currently needs a public unauthenticated Streamable HTTP endpoint and owned namespace/server name.

tools.name: import_repository
tools.description: Inspect a public repository and save an owned launch intake. Infers evidenced public facts and asks only missing facts. No upstream writes or payment.

tools.name: get_launch_intake
tools.description: Read your persisted profile, evidence, missing questions and next action.

tools.name: answer_launch_questions
tools.description: Save explicit public answers to the questions in an owned intake. No upstream mutation or payment.

tools.name: check_launch_coverage
tools.description: Check all implemented destinations with read-only provider requests, remove blocked destinations and preserve prerequisites. Destinations whose topic or eligibility does not fit this server come back as state not_applicable (not a failure; reasons say how to set directory_categories if it fits). Sav

tools.name: prepare_repository
tools.description: Free owner-authenticated inspection at a pinned GitHub revision. Returns exact proposed file diffs, preservation warnings and approval digest. No external writes.

tools.name: get_repository_preparation
tools.description: Read owned pinned patch, warnings and digest before authorizing a PR within existing owner authority or requesting missing approval.

tools.name: create_preparation_pull_request
tools.description: Requires explicit owner approval of the exact displayed patch digest. Creates a branch and PR in the source repository, never merges or publishes. After uncertain writes, only reconciles matching existing PRs; never blindly retries writes.

tools.name: create_publisher_task
tools.description: Free preparation for Claude/OpenAI owner review. Saves a field packet and eligible package; never submits, proves delivery or adds paid coverage. No secrets or credential uploads.

tools.name: list_publisher_tasks
tools.description: Read owned preparation tasks and operator journal status; pending provider work is not fulfillment.

tools.name: get_publisher_task
tools.description: Read the exact owned task revision, digest, missing owner/provider actions and optional authenticated ZIP download link. No raw binary or credentials are returned through MCP.

tools.name: authorize_publisher_task
tools.description: Only use within existing explicit owner authority covering this exact task revision, digest, submit/publish action and truthful attestations; obtain missing authority first. Records a guarded grant, not proof of submission, approval or publication. Does not pay.

tools.name: list_form_tasks
tools.description: Read free prefilled packets (submit URL, exact field values, which free option to choose) for directories that only accept a web form. The owner submits each form; nothing is sent, paid or verified by this service.

tools.name: mark_form_task_submitted
tools.description: Records only that the owner says they submitted the directory form themselves. Not proof of acceptance or listing.

tools.name: run_preflight
tools.description: Requires API key. Read-only provider checks produce an immutable 30-minute report, exact public payloads, blockers and remedies. No external submission or charge occurs. Unsupported/paused destinations cannot be bought.

tools.name: get_preflight
tools.description: Requires API key. Review every target, blocker and proposed public payload with the owner before authorizing a paid launch.

tools.name: create_launch
tools.description: Requires API key and explicit owner authorization of the displayed preflight plans. Creates an unpaid draft bound to a ready owned preflight; this call does not pay. Verified payment later automatically queues the authorized submissions.

tools.name: payment_instructions
tools.description: Read-only protocol instructions for an approved launch_id. No payment is made by this tool. Obtain owner authorization for the saved launch amount (current new-launch offer $49); payment starts automatic submissions.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Requires API key, launch ID and stable purchase key. Human payment fallback for the saved immutable service fee (current new-launch offer $49); only verified paid settlement queues jobs. This tool does not autonomously pay.

tools.name: list_service_cases
tools.description: Read owned delivery reviews, assigned operator, due date and fulfillment summary.

tools.name: get_service_case
tools.description: Read an owned review with operator updates and resolution evidence.

tools.name: reply_to_service_case
tools.description: Add a customer reply or acknowledgement. Never include credentials or private payloads.

tools.name: replace_launch_connection
tools.description: After the owner securely uploads a fresh connection, verify repository ownership and replace the same already-authorized provider for a paid launch. Cannot retry uncertain writes or change submission plans.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Requires API key. Returns your owned order and bound launch after payment or timeout. Do not purchase again while outcome is unknown.

tools.name: list_launches
tools.description: Requires API key. Read durable execution and provider result states.

tools.name: get_launch
tools.description: Requires API key. Read owned jobs, real provider IDs, evidence, ingestion waits and operator-attention states. Submitted is not approved; listed requires matching provider evidence.

tools.name: get_launch_overview
tools.description: Requires API key. One owner-scoped summary of a launch: totals, the refund-commitment promise (qualifying, listed, needed, on track), what is waiting on the owner, and every destination with state, typical review time, links and timeline. Listed always means verified; submitted is not listed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_server, connection_instructions, get_repository_preparation, list_form_tasks, get_preflight, list_service_cases, get_service_case, get_launch_overview · Private data: submit_server, check_status, create_account, get_account, connection_instructions, list_connections, list_servers, create_server, prepare_repository, create_publisher_task, get_publisher_task, authorize_publisher_task, mark_form_task_submitted, run_preflight, get_preflight, create_launch, create_checkout, reply_to_service_case, get_order, list_launches, get_launch, get_launch_overview · Public sink: submit_server, create_account, connection_instructions, authorize_publisher_task, list_form_tasks · Destructive: list_directories, check_launch_coverage, run_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_server, connection_instructions, get_repository_preparation, list_form_tasks, get_preflight, list_service_cases, get_service_case, get_launch_overview · Private data: submit_server, check_status, create_account, get_account, connection_instructions, list_connections, list_servers, create_server, prepare_repository, create_publisher_task, get_publisher_task, authorize_publisher_task, mark_form_task_submitted, run_preflight, get_preflight, create_launch, create_checkout, reply_to_service_case, get_order, list_launches, get_launch, get_launch_overview · Public sink: submit_server, create_account, connection_instructions, authorize_publisher_task, list_form_tasks · Destructive: list_directories, check_launch_coverage, run_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
